تنتزعي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَزِعِي (tantaziʕī) /tan.ta.zi.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# تُنْتَزَعِي (tuntazaʕī) /tun.ta.za.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
